description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named EmployeeAllowedLicenseSearchFilterParams, extending a base FilterParams class. It is used to encapsulate filtering parameters for searching employee license allowances, specifically including an employee number property and specifying allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLicenseSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used to specify filtering parameters for employee license allowances, including employee number and sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameter object and sets the default sort field to 'l.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value, which can be null if unset.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.
